numeric_target_assessment.reason: The README is introduced as output 'like' the shown block, lacks every immutable producer binding, uses random source-default splitting rather than v5 temporal splitting, and labels the model BPRMF while the pinned class is BPR.
numeric_target_assessment.allowed_use: May be retained only as a provisional source-documentation lead when designing a separately frozen official-source protocol; it is not an accepted center, result row, or paper number.

closure_sequence.action: Central replay of hashes and comparison of bounded gaps; select zero or one source candidate only.
Freeze a candidate-specific data and environment materialization proposal, exact scope, and commands for separate user approval.
Acquire and hash only the approved dataset/environment inputs; freeze official target policy, tolerances, config, seeds, adapter, evaluator, and parity fixtures.
Run official-source reproduction and harmonized validation in distinct namespaces; preserve all receipts and negative outcomes.
Open project v5 TEST once only after validation selection, registry, parity, and independent authorization pass.

inference_prohibitions: Do not infer Python, Torch, CUDA, cuDNN, driver, platform, or transitive dependency versions.
Do not infer that current defaults produced README NDCG@10=0.2768.
Do not infer provider bytes from a URL or dataset name.
Do not infer equal-score order from internal item index or torch.topk output.
Do not infer a producer seed, tuning budget, early-stop epoch, checkpoint, or data lineage.
Do not treat source semantic audit as reproducibility verification.
